title: Create: Horizons
description: A modpack that I originally was using for a server with some friends. Then I decided to hop on canva and make it official!
body:
# Modpack:
A simple Create focused modpack made for a server. The mods for create include quality of life mods, like like ones that let you transport kinetic energy, items, and fluids wirelessly. There is also different ways to play, there's exploration and automation, as well different storage solutions, such as Create's Storage Items, Sophisticated Storage, and Storage Drawers. There is also an economy mod installed, since create 6.0 isn't on fabric.

### I don't actively update this project anymore, however any suggestions can be submitted to my [discord server](https://discord.gg/gEjJwKk8gs)
